onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pc_gravity_feel to {{pc_gravity_feel}}]
Set gravity feel to {{pc_gravity_feel}}. Light=6, Standard=9.8, Heavy=18.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pc_friction_mode to {{pc_friction_mode}}]
Set KinematicForceController.frictionCombineMode to {{pc_friction_mode}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pc_bounce to {{pc_bounce}}]
Set restitution preset to {{pc_bounce}}. None=0.0, Low=0.3, Bouncy=0.8.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pt_gravity to {{pt_gravity}}]
Set gravity magnitude to {{pt_gravity}} in CharacterForceControllerBase (applied as negative Y).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pt_fall_speed to {{pt_fall_speed}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.maxFallSpeed to {{pt_fall_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pt_mass to {{pt_mass}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.mass to {{pt_mass}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/category.schema.json, set pt_friction to {{pt_friction}}]
Set KinematicForceController.staticFriction to {{pt_friction}}.
